crossRefs.note: and command them, saying, ‘Take from out of the middle of the Jordan, out of the place where the priests’ feet stood…
The children of Israel did as Joshua commanded, and took up twelve stones out of the middle of the Jordan, as Yahweh…

people.name: Gilgal
people.line: A significant site during Israel's early history in Canaan.

people.name: Jordan
people.line: A river and region, significant in Israel's history

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

translations.web: Joshua set up those twelve stones, which they took out of the Jordan, in Gilgal.
translations.bsb: And there at Gilgal Joshua set up the twelve stones they had taken from the Jordan.
translations.kjv: And those twelve stones, which they took out of Jordan, did Joshua pitch in Gilgal.
translations.asv: And those twelve stones, which they took out of the Jordan, did Joshua set up in Gilgal.
